content.short: Ekubo is a high-performance AMM on Starknet, featuring concentrated liquidity and an extensible singleton design.
content.description: Ekubo is a next-generation decentralized exchange and AMM purpose-built for the Starknet ecosystem. It introduces a highly efficient singleton architecture, where all pools are managed within a single smart contract to minimize gas costs and maximize capital efficiency. By implementing concentrated liquidity, Ekubo allows LPs to provide capital within specific price ranges, significantly enhancing market depth and reducing slippage. The protocol is designed with extensibility at its core, utilizing a powerful 'hooks' system that allows developers to build custom logic directly onto the exchange, enabling the creation of complex financial instruments.
content.meta: Explore Ekubo, the Starknet AMM with concentrated liquidity and extensible hooks, designed for maximum capital efficiency on Lancers Web3.
